headline: Site Reliability Engineer | DevOps and Cloud Infrastructure
summary: Highly motivated Site Reliability Engineer with 5 years of experience ensuring the stability, scalability, and performance of mission-critical applications. Proven ability to automate infrastructure deployments, monitor system health, and implement proactive measures to minimize downtime. Passionate about building robust and resilient systems using cutting-edge technologies.

bullets: Reduced system downtime by 25% through the implementation of automated incident response systems and proactive performance monitoring.
Increased application throughput by 15% by optimizing Kubernetes deployments and leveraging serverless architectures.
Developed and maintained infrastructure-as-code (IaC) scripts using Terraform to streamline provisioning and configuration of cloud resources.
Collaborated with development teams to implement continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, resulting in faster release cycles and improved deployment reliability.
Assisted in the migration of on-premise infrastructure to AWS, successfully transitioning over 50 servers and applications to the cloud.
Monitored system performance using Prometheus and Grafana, identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks that were impacting application responsiveness.
Developed and implemented automation scripts using Go to streamline repetitive tasks and improve efficiency of deployment processes.
